findings.subject: Personalization axes (brand, surface, surface tint, radius, type scale, density, font, mode)
findings.summary: Carried from r2-tokens-2: on a nested scope the radius and type-scale axes do nothing, although the source comments say a subtree can override them.
findings.evidence: foundation/radius.css:12-37 and foundation/typography.css:18-49 compute the ramps on :root; radius.css:12-14 and type-scale.css:7-10 promise subtree overrides; packages/ui-react/src/components/story-probes.tsx:111 works around it.
findings.fix: Re-declare the computed --radius-* and --typography-* ramps on [data-a63-radius] and [data-a63-type-scale] (as density does), and add a nested-scope assertion to personalization-axes.browser.test.ts.

findings.subject: Theme: aqua

findings.fix: Add the descendant forms ([data-a63-theme='aqua'] :is(.dark,[data-a63-mode='dark'])) and a nested mode-only contrast case.

findings.subject: Theme: terminal

findings.fix: Target [data-separator='active'] (and style [data-separator='disabled']); baseline a dragging state.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: The resizable handle line is invisible in forced-colors mode and the splitter's keyboard behaviour has no test here.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-21. packages/ui-react/src/components/resizable/resizable.css:25; packages/ui-react/src/components/resizable/resizable.test.tsx (no keyboard/aria-valuenow assertions).
findings.fix: Add the forced-colors rule (see the separator finding) and a keyboard test (Arrow keys change aria-valuenow).

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: Resizable has no RTL story or test, so horizontal layout and arrow-key direction under dir=rtl are unverified.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-22. packages/ui-react/src/components/resizable/resizable.stories.tsx (no dir=rtl story); resizable.test.tsx.
findings.fix: Add an RTL story/baseline and a keyboard test under dir=rtl.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: Resizable tests cover rendering only: no keyboard resize, value or drag-state test.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-23. packages/ui-react/src/components/resizable/resizable.test.tsx:7-72 (5 render tests).
findings.fix: Add keyboard and drag-state tests.

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: The scrollFade mask fades the wrong edges in right-to-left layouts: it maps the logical x-start/x-end overflow to physical right/left gradients.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-24. packages/ui-react/src/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.css:52-60; Base UI computes start/end logically (node_modules/@base-ui/react/scroll-area/viewport/ScrollAreaViewport.js:141-147); apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-scrollablelist-right-to-left-chromium-linux.png (start edge faded, hidden end edge hard-cut).
findings.fix: Swap the two horizontal gradients under :dir(rtl) (or wrap with Base UI's DirectionProvider and mirror); baseline an RTL ScrollArea with scrollFade.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: ScrollableList's default edge mask fades the wrong edge in RTL (same root cause as the ScrollArea mask), visible in its own RTL baseline.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-25. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-scrollablelist-right-to-left-chromium-linux.png; packages/ui-react/src/components/scrollable-list/scrollable-list.tsx:298 (scrollFade={mask}); the scroll-area mask (scroll-area.css:52-60) is unchanged since r2.
findings.fix: Fixed by the scroll-area RTL mask fix; re-baseline RightToLeft.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: With draggable on, ScrollableList captures the pointer on every pointerdown before any movement, which can retarget the following click to the viewport so list items never get clicked (needs a browser check); the prop also shadows HTML draggable.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-26. packages/ui-react/src/components/scrollable-list/scrollable-list.tsx:166-173 (setPointerCapture in onPointerDown before any movement), 39 (draggable prop); no test clicks an item in a draggable list. Only the "use client" line changed since r2.
findings.fix: Capture only after the 3px movement threshold (in onPointerMove); add a browser test that clicking a button inside a draggable list fires it; consider renaming to dragToScroll.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel exposes a `variant` axis ('button-group' | 'default') that its contract does not list.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-27. packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.tsx:77,89,106; packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/connected-panel.json (aligns, slots, states only).
findings.fix: Add variants [default, button-group] to connected-panel.json, generate the type, and import it instead of the local union.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel widths are px numbers (192/320, content calc(320px - 2px)), so they ignore text scaling and density.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-28. packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.tsx:97,101,136-140.
findings.fix: Default to rem or token-based widths and derive content width from the panel (100%) instead of a fixed calc.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: In a container narrower than expandedWidth the panel shrinks to max-width:100% but its content keeps a fixed calc(320px - 2px) width and is clipped.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-29. packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.css:14 (max-width:100%) vs connected-panel.tsx:331-338 (fixed content width) and css:334-338 (overflow:hidden).
findings.fix: Size the content clip with min(contentWidth, 100%) and add a 320px phone-width story.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel content scales from a physical corner (top left/top right), so in RTL the start-aligned panel grows from the wrong corner.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-30. packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.css:346-356.
findings.fix: Swap the origins under :dir(rtl) or compute from align + direction.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: The ConnectedPanel trigger's aria-controls points at a content id that is unmounted while closed (default forceMount=false).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k06-surfaces-31. packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.tsx:243 vs 342.
findings.fix: Set aria-controls only while the content is mounted, as Accordion does.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: With autoPlay under reduced motion the resting truncated line keeps the edge mask, so its first glyph is faded out.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-3. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.css:47-58 mask on [data-overflowing][data-autoplay]; reduced-motion block :151-171 restores content opacity but not the mask; ui-react-textticker-themes-chromium-linux.png.
findings.fix: In the reduced-motion block set mask-image: none on the autoplay selector (and only apply the mask while the track animates).

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: The marquee loop always moves left, so in right-to-left text it scrolls the wrong way and leaves a blank edge.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-4. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.css:142-149 keyframes translateX(calc(-50% - var(--a63-text-ticker-gap) / 2)) with no direction variable; compare marquee.css:13-28 --marquee-dir; no RightToLeft export in text-ticker.stories.tsx.
findings.fix: Add a --text-ticker-dir set to -1 under :dir(rtl) and multiply the translate by it, as Marquee does; add a RightToLeft story.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: Truncated text is revealed only on hover or focus-within, so touch users can never read it (this also hits every SidebarNavTree label).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-7. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.css:82-103 and :122-128 activation selectors are :hover/:focus-within/[data-autoplay] only; packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar-nav-tree/sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:37-41, 176-180, 277-279 wrap labels in TextTicker.
findings.fix: Reveal on tap/press for coarse pointers or expose the full text (e.g. title or a tooltip trigger) and document it.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: On phones the Sidebar spreads its div props onto the Sheet root, so className, id, aria-*, style and ref are dropped there but applied on desktop.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-8. packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.tsx:272 <Sheet onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} open={openMobile} {...props}> vs :305-314 container and :256-266 static div.
findings.fix: Forward className/style/ref/DOM props to SheetContent on the mobile path; keep only Sheet root props on <Sheet>.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: The active menu button and sub-button are marked only by a background fill, which disappears in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-9. packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.css:496-504, :747 fill only; grep -c forced-colors sidebar.css = 0; packages/ui-react/src/styles/recipes.test.ts:443-462 list omits sidebar, calendar and carousel.
findings.fix: Add an @media (forced-colors: active) rule painting active items in Highlight/HighlightText and add sidebar to the recipes test list.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Selected and range days are drawn only by background, so the selection is invisible in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-10; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:204-214; grep -c forced-colors calendar.css = 0.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule (Highlight/HighlightText on selected, a border on range-middle) and add calendar to recipes.test.ts 'state that survives forced colors'.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The day focus ring is the focus colour at 50% alpha, weaker than every other control's ring and likely below 3:1 on the selected fill.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-11; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:241-245 color-mix(in oklch, var(--a63-focus-ring) 50%, transparent); nav buttons use the full ring at :95-98.
findings.fix: Use the standard ring (var(--a63-control-focus-ring-color, var(--a63-focus-ring))) with an offset so it reads on the selected fill.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Calendar silently drops every caller classNames key it does not style itself (root, selected, disabled, week, month_grid and others).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-12; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.tsx:86 destructures classNames out of props; :115-123 copies only keys of defaultClassNames.
findings.fix: Start from {...classNames} and cn() the default class into each known key.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Day buttons are 36px on a coarse-pointer device outside the phone form factor, below the 44px target.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-13; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:11-14 --cell-size = max(control-height-lg, control-min-size); atom63 token --a63-control-height-lg = space-unit*9 (36px) and --a63-control-min-size touch = 2rem.
findings.fix: Floor --cell-size at --a63-control-min-target (2.75rem on touch) and add a touch/phone story with a baseline.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Localization and direction are only partly wired: the month dropdown ignores the locale prop, day labels append English words, and RTL depends on both an ancestor dir attribute and DayPicker's own dir prop.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-14; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.tsx:155 toLocaleString('default', ...); :67-68 'Today, ' and ', selected'; calendar.css:106-108 [dir='rtl'] chevron flip vs react-day-picker 10.0.2 DayPicker.js:178-182 and 270/297 (keys and around-nav chevrons follow props.dir only).
findings.fix: Format with options.locale?.code, take the today/selected words from the caller's labels, read direction from context or computed style and pass it as dir, and add an RTL story.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: No phone or touch story exists, so calendar behaviour at 390px and on coarse pointers is never captured.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-15; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.stories.tsx exports Playground, Range, DropdownCaption, MultipleMonths, Themes, Endpoints, ContractMetadata only.
findings.fix: Add a Phone story (390px baseline) inside layout='phone' or a Popover.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: With cursorIndicator, any click inside the carousel (a link in a slide, a dot, the Prev/Next button) also navigates by pointer half, causing double or wrong scrolls.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-16; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:243 root onClick=handleCursorClick, :201-215 no event.target check; test carousel.test.tsx:190 clicks only the root.
findings.fix: Ignore clicks whose target is inside an interactive element (closest('a,button,input,[role=button]')) or listen on the viewport only; add a test clicking a dot and a slide button.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Caller props override internal wiring: a ref on Carousel replaces the direction/cursor ref, and onClick or disabled on CarouselPrevious/Next replaces navigation.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-17; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:248-250 ref before {...props}; :361-364 and :384-387 onClick/disabled before {...props}.
findings.fix: Merge refs; compose onClick (call the caller's, then scroll unless defaultPrevented) as SidebarTrigger does (sidebar.tsx:316-319).

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Arrow keys are captured for the whole region (breaking caret movement in inputs inside slides) and a vertical carousel uses Left/Right instead of Up/Down; dots vanish in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-18; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:129-143 + :244 onKeyDownCapture with preventDefault; carousel.css:192-208 dot drawn only as ::before background, no forced-colors rule.
findings.fix: Handle keys in bubble phase and skip editable targets; map ArrowUp/Down for vertical; add a forced-colors rule (CanvasText rest, Highlight current).

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Round dots keep a 24px-wide target on touch, below 44px.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-19; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.css:170-172 --carousel-dot-pitch: 1.5rem for shape='dot' regardless of pointer; :181-185 width = pitch.
findings.fix: Use max(1.5rem, var(--a63-control-min-target)) or a coarse-pointer override for the pitch.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: Orientation is a boolean `vertical` instead of the contract's orientation axis, and the props type omits ref (the only component typed with ComponentPropsWithoutRef).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-20; unchanged at f7e5e419. marquee.tsx:12, :26; marquee-contract.ts:6 orientations horizontal|vertical with no default; grep ComponentPropsWithoutRef in ui-react components: 1 file.
findings.fix: Add orientation?: MarqueeOrientation (default 'horizontal' in the contract) and deprecate vertical; type props as ComponentProps<'div'>.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: The pause toggle and running state are never captured, because visual tests run with reduced motion, which hides the toggle.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-21; unchanged at f7e5e419. apps/storybook/vitest.config.ts:109 reducedMotion 'reduce'; marquee.css:97-99; ui-react-marquee-pause-toggle-chromium-linux.png shows no toggle.
findings.fix: Give the PauseToggle story reducedMotion 'no-preference' with the animation paused (paused state is deterministic) so the toggle over content is baselined.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: Parts take no DOM props or ref, and SidebarNavCollapsibleItem has no uncontrolled mode (open and onOpenChange are required).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-22; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:77-86, 128-152, 213-228, 285-293, 319-322 closed interfaces; :224-225 required open/onOpenChange.
findings.fix: Extend each props type with the wrapped element's props and spread them; add defaultOpen to SidebarNavCollapsibleItem.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: The section toggle's name is hardcoded English ('Expand X' / 'Collapse X') with no prop to localize it, and there is no RTL story.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-23; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:254; sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx has no RightToLeft export.
findings.fix: Use a static, caller-provided toggle label (e.g. toggleLabel, defaulting to the section label) and rely on aria-expanded for state; add an RTL story.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: No phone story, and long labels rely on the hover/focus ticker, so truncated labels are unreadable on touch.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-24; unchanged at f7e5e419. grep viewport|phone|mobile in sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx = 0; text-ticker.css:61-82.
findings.fix: Add a DarkSidebarPhone-style story with long labels; resolve with r2-k07-frame-7.

findings.subject: app-view
findings.summary: Default landmark names are music-app specific ('Library' for the panel, 'Player' for the docked bar), so other products ship wrong accessible names silently.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-27; unchanged at f7e5e419. app-view.tsx:94 bottomBarLabel='Player', :101 panelLabel='Library'.
findings.fix: Use neutral defaults (e.g. 'Sidebar', 'Toolbar') or require the label when the region is passed; mention it in the docs guidance.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: marqueeSpeed is a loop duration in seconds, so a higher 'speed' is slower.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-28. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.tsx:41, :149 '--a63-text-ticker-duration': `${Math.max(1, marqueeSpeed)}s`.
findings.fix: Rename to marqueeDuration (keep marqueeSpeed as a deprecated alias) and document the unit.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The modern, aqua and retro calendars are visually identical; the declared archetypes do not show per theme.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-29; unchanged at f7e5e419. ui-react-calendar-themes-chromium-linux.png (only terminal differs).
findings.fix: Decide whether day cells and nav buttons should take the theme's control material (retro bevel, aqua gloss) like Button.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: The link-row toggle changes its name with its state while also exposing aria-expanded, so state is announced twice.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-31; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:253-258.
findings.fix: Keep a static name and let aria-expanded carry the state (folds into r2-k07-frame-23).

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: useReducedMotion decides the markup during render (toggle, role, tabIndex), so server and reduced-motion client markup differ on hydration.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-32; unchanged at f7e5e419. marquee.tsx:57-60, :86; apps/storybook/ssr/ssr.test.tsx only checks that renderToString succeeds.
findings.fix: Render the toggle and let CSS hide it under reduced motion (already done at marquee.css:97-99), and set the scroll-region attributes after mount.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: The rail hairline is still placed with physical left, and the RTL story covers only the static collapsible="none" sidebar, so the desktop collapsible path under dir=rtl has no baseline.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.css:261 (left: 50%), :288 (left: 100% for offcanvas); sidebar.stories.tsx:284-288 RightToLeft renders <Sidebar collapsible="none">.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start on the rail ::after, and add a RightToLeft story with the default offcanvas/icon sidebar inside a fixed-height frame, with a baseline.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: Reduced motion and ResizeObserver re-measurement are still untested; the new tests cover overflow, autoPlay and the pause toggle only.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.test.tsx:64-147 (no matchMedia/useReducedMotion stub, no resize callback).
findings.fix: Stub useReducedMotion to assert no toggle and no data-control, and fire the ResizeObserver callback to assert data-overflowing flips.

findings.subject: load-more-trigger
findings.summary: State is settable two ways (state prop vs isLoading/hasMore booleans), the root takes no rest props, and the children path drops the live region.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-3. packages/ui-react/src/components/load-more-trigger/load-more-trigger.tsx:14-27 (props), :55 (resolution), :58-69 (children path without role=status/aria-live), :74-85 (no rest spread).
findings.fix: Deprecate isLoading/hasMore in favour of state; spread remaining div props onto the root; keep role=status/aria-live on the children path too.

findings.subject: load-more-trigger
findings.summary: The Retry action still has no hover style and a focus ring that bypasses the focus-ring tokens (the failed state is now captured across themes).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-4. packages/ui-react/src/components/load-more-trigger/load-more-trigger.css:88-99 (no :hover), :111-115 (outline: 2px solid var(--load-more-accent)); FailedThemes story fixed the capture gap.
findings.fix: Render Retry as a DS Button (ghost/link, size sm) or give it hover + token focus ring (--a63-control-focus-ring-width/-color); extend Themes to the failed state.

findings.subject: feedback-state
findings.summary: FeedbackState contract states now match, but its visual archetype is still "action" (CLI: "Action controls") for a surface pattern.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-6. packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/feedback-state.json:22 visualArchetypes ["action"]; packages/cli/generated/agent-index.json Feedback State entry "Visual archetype: Action controls".
findings.fix: Set visualArchetypes to ["surface"] and regenerate contracts and the agent index.

findings.subject: alert
findings.summary: AlertAction is absolutely positioned against a fixed 72px reserve, so a longer or translated label, or two actions, overlaps the title and description.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-7; unchanged at f7e5e419. alert.css:15 (--alert-action-reserve: calc(--a63-space-6 * 3)), :55-57 (padding-inline-end reserve), :104-110 (position:absolute). No long-label or CJK story; RTL story uses a short label.
findings.fix: Put the action in its own grid column (auto) instead of absolute positioning, or reserve its measured width; add a long-label/CJK story at phone width.

findings.subject: badge
findings.summary: Badge heights and padding are literal rems and font sizes are ±1px calcs, so compact density does not reach Badge.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-9. packages/ui-react/src/components/badge/badge.css:10-11, :128-137 literal rem heights/padding and ±1px font calcs.
findings.fix: Derive height/padding from --a63-space-unit (or control-height tokens) times --a63-density-scale, as Button does (button.css:46-47).

findings.subject: badge
findings.summary: Interactive badges have a barely visible hover (88% alpha of the same fill) and no active state; hover and focus are now captured.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-10. packages/ui-react/src/components/badge/badge.css:271-279; baselines ui-react-badge-interactive-hover / -focus-visible-chromium-linux.png show the weak hover.

findings.subject: avatar

findings.subject: avatar

findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-14; unchanged at f7e5e419. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-avatar-themes-chromium-linux.png; avatar.json visualArchetypes ["marker"].

findings.subject: animated-check

findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-22; unchanged at f7e5e419. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-animatedcheck-playground/-dark/-static-sizes-chromium-linux.png; animated-check.stories.tsx exports Playground, StaticSizes, Dark only.

findings.subject: animated-check

findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-23; unchanged at f7e5e419. animated-check.tsx:6-32,70.
findings.fix: Read duration/easing from --a63-motion-* tokens and move the CSS to the shared stylesheet.

findings.subject: alert
findings.summary: Warning alerts default to role="alert", so a persistent warning present at page load is announced assertively.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k08-24; unchanged at f7e5e419. alert.tsx:14-20.

findings.subject: feedback-state

findings.subject: chat-composer

findings.subject: chat-composer

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx blocks (Callout, ColorSwatchItem, Compare, ComparisonPair, CreditsBlock, DocExample, DocExampleCode, ExampleContainer, FigureBlock, KeyIdea, LayerStack, MdxPageSkeleton, MediaCaption, MediaPlaceholder, MermaidDiagram, PageMeta, PageTableOfContents, ResourceList, ScrollStage, StatCard, StatGrid, Steps, Timeline, VideoBlock)

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformBanner, InformDialog, InformCornerFlyout, InformFlyoutStack, InformSpotlight

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetCard parts, WidgetAvatar, WidgetStateFeedback, WidgetImage

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformBanner, InformCornerFlyout, InformSpotlight

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx ImageCompare
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-10: ImageCompare's slider is named with the library's fixed English instruction, not the before/after labels, and authors cannot translate it.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformDialog

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformCornerFlyout (InformFlyoutStack)
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-12: The flyout stack is placed a fixed space-4 from the corner and ignores safe-area insets, so on notched or home-indicator phones a card can sit under system UI.

findings.fix: Add env(safe-area-inset-*) to the stack's side and anchored-edge offsets (max(offset, inset)), and a Phone story.

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetAvatar
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-13: Pressing shuffle from the keyboard disables the focused button, which drops focus to the page, and the busy state is not announced.

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetAvatar
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-14: On touch screens the shuffle affordance is invisible: it shows only on hover, keyboard focus or while busy, and its target is not lifted to 44px.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx ResourceList

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx DocExample
